about: Rows cmux has sent to the shared regex-after-token table (regex-after-token.json, pinned in regex-after-token.json.pin) and that the pinned copy does not hold yet, in its row form, read as TSX. From the review of manaflow-ai/cmux#41377. Drop a row here once the pinned table holds it.

rows.why: review of manaflow-ai/cmux#41377, F1: a bare attribute named extends keeps a JSX tag (only <T extends U>(x) => is type parameters); the element's text //x is text, and what follows the element is code

rows.source: const f = <T = string>(x: T) => x // echo > /tmp/out.$$
rows.why: F2: U+00A0 is ECMAScript WhiteSpace, so <T = string> is still a defaulted type parameter, not a JSX tag; the // after the arrow is a comment
F3: a ! right after a name is the postfix non-null assertion, so the expression is complete and < is a comparison, not a JSX tag; the // is a comment
